points.quote: Notice is given under Section 22.2(3) of the Forest and Range Practices Act that the Hangover FSR (8229.06) is hereby closed at 0.0 km effective immediately until further notice.
This action is in response to the current condition of the Bonanza River Bridge at 0km timber rails and a landslide at 3.4km, posing a safety risk to road users.
